title: healthsim: Simulate Synthetic Health Insurance Portfolios and Panels
description: R package that generates synthetic South African health insurance data with a known data-generating process, for teaching and testing pricing models: a cross-sectional portfolio with negative binomial claim counts and a lognormal-Pareto severity mixture, and a multi-year open-cohort panel with wearables joined by a Clayton copula, claims inflation, annual benefit limits, lapses and deaths.
